item.title: Why developers are ditching GitHub for Codeberg and self-hosting alternatives
item.description:
📝 Some key players have abandoned GitHub A slow trickle that may gain momentum When you’re searching for open-source software, it can seem like every project is hosted on GitHub. Aside from these departures, those projects that have always avoided GitHub have their own reasons. ” Close Alternatives to GitHub are doing well From self-hosting to Codeberg, various options are available Codeberg is probably the singular most popular competing service that projects like Zig have chosen to abandon GitHub for.
🔗 Read more: https://www.howtogeek.com/why-developers-are-ditching-github-for-codeberg-and-self-hosting-alternatives/
